visual_language.medium: Hand-painted gouache and transparent ink on cold-press cotton paper, with opaque and translucent passages sharing one tactile image surface.
visual_language.surface: Visible cold-press paper tooth, matte pigment, occasional dry-brush grain, and translucent staining remain legible rather than digitally smoothed away.
visual_language.mark_making: Visible brushwork and wash behavior: dragged dry brush, translucent ink blooms, family-specific pencil/pastel/stipple accents, and crisp opaque touches used selectively.
visual_language.signature_accent: Selective crystal-white highlights and restrained luminous bloom, with occasional prismatic or metallic accents reserved for magic, crystals, and moments of revelation.
visual_language.finish: Tactile, handmade stylized illustrative realism: recognizable creatures and expressive silhouettes, neither photorealistic nor chibi, with material texture retained through the final image.
avoid: uniform digital surfaces that erase paper tooth
